descriptions.d10b_decode_radices_8026c96c: Decode an unsigned encoded value into descending cumulative radix quotients and a permuted ten-field result. Preserve unsigned division and remainder, signed product-loop bounds, modulo-width product arithmetic and the saved original encoded return. Original unsigned-halfword table at 0x803cbcb0 independently decoded from the DOL and remains an unowned const external; partial state view only.
